### **NASA Earthdata Harmony Transformation Services**

Harmony provides access to services that can transform data from NASA's Earthdata Cloud.  Transformation services available may include spatial subsetting, temporal subsetting, variable subsetting, reformatting, and reprojection.  *Not all data have transformation services available and the available services vary by data set.*  Transformations can be requested using one of two Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) inspired APIs.

Query the Harmony Capabilities endpoint using the collection concept-ID or short name to determine whether your collection has Harmony services enabled.  Supply the url in a browser or use curl to request the json response in the terminal.

`https://harmony.earthdata.nasa.gov/capabilities?collectionId=<collection-concept-id>`

`https://harmony.earthdata.nasa.gov/capabilities?shortName=<collection-short-name>`

Harmony documentation can be found [here](https://harmony.earthdata.nasa.gov/docs).

You can use the Harmony APIs and endpoints to [interact with Harmony directly](https://nsidc.org/data/user-resources/help-center/harmony-api-quickstart-guide-customizing-nasa-nsidc-daac-data-earthdata-cloud). The [`harmony-py` Python library](https://github.com/nasa/harmony-py) is the recommended option for Python users.
